notes: receive transfer: types EFFECT 6 / TRNS_TYPE 9, must match a pending approved ST_TRNSFER, lines copied from the issue; wave 3: soft delete (transfer pending again), duplicate DOC_NO question, receipt status and totals (APP_ACT_ST)

ST_TRNS_DET.ITEM_NAME.sql: (select max(nvl(i.name_e, i.name_a)) from st_item i where i.item_group_code = t.group_code and i.item_code = t.item_code)

ST_TRNS_DET.STORE_BALANCE.sql: round(nvl(get_balance_confg(t.store_code, t.group_code, t.item_code, t.item_confg_id, t.trns_date, t.date_serial, t.item_serial), 0) / nvl((select max(u.factor) from st_item_unit u where u.group_code = t.group_code and u.item_code = t.item_code and u.unit_code = t.unit_code), 1), 3)

ST_TRNS_DET.ITEM_COST_CONFG.sql: case when (nvl(to_number(v('G_PASSWORD_NUMBER')), 0) = 0 or ((select nvl(max(b.show_cost), 0) from st_basic b) = 1 and (select nvl(max(u.allow_view_cost), 0) from users u where u.users_code = to_number(v('G_USER_CODE'))) = 1)) then get_unit_cost_confg(t.store_code, t.group_code, t.item_code, t.item_confg_id, t.trns_date, t.date_serial, t.item_serial) * nvl((select max(u.factor) from st_item_unit u where u.group_code = t.group_code and u.item_code = t.item_code and u.unit_code = t.unit_code), 1) end

ST_TRNS_MAST.TRNSFER_SERIAL.lov: select t.trnsfer_serial || ' - ' || s.name_a || ' - ' || to_char(t.trnsfer_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') d, t.trnsfer_serial r from st_trnsfer t, st_store s where s.store_code = t.trnsfer_from_store and t.trnsfer_receiving_date is null and nvl(t.delete_flag, 0) = 0 and t.approve_flag = 1 and t.trnsfer_to_store = :PAGE_STORE_CODE order by t.trnsfer_serial

ST_TRNS_MAST.TRNSFER_FROM_STORE.lov: select distinct s.store_code || ' - ' || s.name_a d, s.store_code r from st_trnsfer t, st_store s where s.store_code = t.trnsfer_from_store and t.trnsfer_serial = :PAGE_TRNSFER_SERIAL and t.trnsfer_to_store = :PAGE_STORE_CODE order by 2

ST_TRNS_DET.ITEM_CONFG_ID.lov: select c.item_confg_id || ' - ' || c.lot_number || ' - ' || to_char(c.expire_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') d, c.item_confg_id r from st_item_confg c where c.item_code = :PAGE_ITEM_CODE order by c.expire_date, c.item_confg_id

rules.where: TRNS_TYPE_CODE in (select t.trns_type_code from st_trns_type t where t.effect = 6 and t.trns_type = 9) and nvl(DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0 and (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 or TRNS_TYPE_CODE in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))

after_save.name: legacy commit rules (lines required, balances, receive lines)
